+++ "b/C:\\Users\\FAZLUL\\Desktop\\MainProject\\SuperContext\\eval\\runs\\phase8-continuation\\2026-10-27T06-06-47-463Z\\json-server-h04-r1-A\\patch-files\\lib\\in-memory-http.mjs"
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { Server } from 'node:http'
+import { Duplex } from 'node:stream'
+
+const servers = new Map()
+let nextPort = 10000
+Server.prototype.listen = function () {
+  const port = nextPort++
+  servers.set(port, this)
+  this.address = () => ({ address: '127.0.0.1', family: 'IPv4', port })
+  process.nextTick(() => this.emit('listening'))
+  return this
+}
+Server.prototype.close = function (callback) {
+  servers.delete(this.address().port)
+  process.nextTick(() => {
+    this.emit('close')
+    callback?.()
+  })
+  return this
+}
+globalThis.fetch = async (input) => {
+  const url = new URL(input)
+  assert.equal(url.hostname, '127.0.0.1')
+  const server = servers.get(Number(url.port))
+  assert.ok(server, 'in-memory server must exist')
+  const raw = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const chunks = []
+    const socket = new Duplex({
+      read() {},
+      write(chunk, encoding, callback) {
+        chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk))
+        callback()
+      },
+    })
+    socket.on('error', reject)
+    socket.on('finish', () => {
+      resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks))
+      socket.destroy()
+    })
+    server.emit('connection', socket)
+    socket.push(`GET ${url.pathname}${url.search} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: ${url.host}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n`)
+  })
+  const boundary = raw.indexOf('\r\n\r\n')
+  const [statusLine, ...headerLines] = raw.subarray(0, boundary).toString().split('\r\n')
+  const headers = new Headers()
+  for (const line of headerLines) {
+    const index = line.indexOf(':')
+    headers.append(line.slice(0, index), line.slice(index + 1).trim())
+  }
+  let body = raw.subarray(boundary + 4)
+  if (headers.get('transfer-encoding') === 'chunked') {
+    const chunks = []
+    while (body.length) {
+      const index = body.indexOf('\r\n')
+      const size = parseInt(body.subarray(0, index).toString(), 16)
+      if (!size) break
+      chunks.push(body.subarray(index + 2, index + 2 + size))
+      body = body.subarray(index + 2 + size + 2)
+    }
+    body = Buffer.concat(chunks)
+  }
+  return new Response(body, { status: Number(statusLine.split(' ')[1]), headers })
+}
